text: Add water to the mix and it will turn into paste.
translation: 往混合物里加水，它会变成糊。
note: 掺在一起的东西 = 混合物。

text: He bought a mix of red and blue for the wall.
clue: a mix of red and blue
translation: 他买了红蓝混合的墙漆。

text: That cake mix comes in three different tastes.
translation: 那款蛋糕预拌粉有三种口味。

text: The mix of colours on that wall is very warm.
translation: 那面墙上的颜色混合很温暖。

text: I like the mix of sweet and salt in it.
translation: 我喜欢里面甜咸交织的味道。

text: There was a real mix in the city after the storm.
translation: 风暴后城里一片混乱。

text: The whole mix of people and noise tired her out.
translation: 人和噪音混杂让她疲惫不堪。

text: His life has been a mix of luck and hard work.
translation: 他的人生是运气与努力混杂的。

text: Nobody could sort out the mix of feelings inside her.
translation: 没人能理清她内心混乱的情绪。

text: The office was in a mix after the sudden move.
translation: 突然搬动后办公室一片混乱。

text: He looked mix after the long night drive.
translation: 长途夜驾后他看起来很糊涂。

text: She felt mix when no one explained it well.
translation: 没人好好解释时她感到糊涂。

text: Their answers were so mix that nobody trusted them.
translation: 他们的答复含糊得没人相信。

text: I was really mix for a whole day after that news.
translation: 听到那消息后我一整天都很糊涂。

text: His mix reply made the plan go wrong.
translation: 他含糊的答复把计划弄乱了。

text: Mix the eggs and the flour in one big bowl.
translation: 把鸡蛋和面粉在一只大碗里混合。
note: mix A and B = 使混合。

text: I always mix sugar into my morning tea.
translation: 我总把糖拌进早茶里。

text: Mix the paint before you use it, please.
translation: 用之前请把漆搅拌一下。

text: She mixed the old words with the new ones.
clue: the old words with the new
translation: 她把旧词和新词混在一起。

text: Do not mix those two kinds of wood together.
translation: 那两种木头不要混着用。
note: mix A and B = 使混合。
